page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by a dedicated 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor built on x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 4 physical cores offering 8 vCPUs via hyperthreading, paired with 16.0 GB of system memory to maintain a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core. Its cache subsystem features 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache per core, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512 with VNNI, AES, and FMA. This server configuration lacks bundled local storage and relies on network-attached storage, supported by a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile.

Benchmark evaluation shows average multi-core processing capability alongside weaker single-threaded throughput. The instance recorded a stress-ng multi-core score of 6986.33 and a PassMark CPU score of 8224.85, establishing solid performance in multi-threaded operational tests. In contrast, single-core scores such as Geekbench (1140.0) and stress-ng single-core (1312.09) reflect entry-tier single-thread performance. Memory bandwidth benchmarks yielded 49.44 GB/sec for uncached reads and 36.78 GB/sec for uncached writes. Database throughput reached 2796.92 operations in PassMark testing and 6.6 million Redis SET operations per second.

The ecs.c6.2xlarge balances dedicated vCPU allocations and broad vector instruction support against modest single-core speed and baseline network limits. The inclusion of AVX-512 VNNI assists vectorized mathematical operations without requiring dedicated GPU acceleration. This profile makes the instance well suited for software compilation tasks, multi-threaded backend batch processing, in-memory caching with Redis, and relational database operations.
